svg.text: TEXAS PERSONAL AUTO POLICY TX 01-PAP-003 • EXCLUSIONS (PAGE 4 OF 51)
EXCLUSIONS: We do not provide Liability Coverage for any covered person...
We do not provide Liability Coverage for any covered person using or operating a vehicle
located inside a facility designed for racing, or for prearranged racing or speed contests.
Telematics speed proof (26 MPH in 30 MPH posted zone) and continuous single-vehicle video
affirmatively refutes any speed contest or reckless operation. Exclusion inapplicable.
